**Deliverables written**
- `research/physics-em-sr-40-2026-10-08-batch-29.pages.json` — complete A/B array: 7 A items (2 postulates with `physics_review`-ready formulations and 5 proved-here candidates with full statements, proof strategies, roles, units, scopes) and 3 B examples; all `deps` sorted with roles, whole-run `dependency_level` labels 13/14/15/16/16/17/17 and 17/17/17, published atomically from a scratch file.

- `...-batch-29.cross-batch-dependencies.json` — 45 rows (2 page + 43 item) covering every declared cross-batch edge (36 to batch 23; 3 to batch 13; one each to batches 1, 16, 19, 24).
- `...-batch-29.notes.md` — design/plan comparison, recorded dep additions and role corrections, AC declarations and uses, source stamps/drops, level table, and exact check outputs.
- Ten `...-step1-<item>.json` readiness records (all `ready` with current hashes), and the refreshed unified ledger.

- Four short Fitzpatrick sub-pages failed the fetch checker's substantive-text floor; complete drop records (initial + 5 retries, two real searches, per-item alternatives) were written, and the search located and stamped the complete 364-page book version of the same course as the alternative carrier.

**Checks actually run** — `item-dependency-levels` (no batch-29 error), `step1-decisions` (361/361 items ready; all ten of mine closed), `content-policy --manifest-only` (0/0), `coverage-checklist --require-destination` (0/0), `source-fetch-check` (8/12 stamped, 12/12 resolved with 4 documented drops), `url-sweep` (8/8 live), `source-backing --require-verified` (all backed), `manifest-integrity` (no scope drift), `drift-review-check` (40 pages, no blocked edges), `validate-plan` (OK — the two initial `undeclared-prereq` errors resolved). `frontier-item-gate … extcheck --manifest-only` cannot run while sibling batches 25–27, 30 and 34–40 still have empty inventories — recorded as a run-wide condition, not a batch-29 finding.
